How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f564ca1732ae0b1297b21a66220f79eb19265cf7cbe8b0bdc4f9c67f632e292c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Count all the triangles formed by individual small sections and by combining them into larger triangles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03e2e47526a5b1d8bb785b93701994a441329f180a593a37fa41b44efc4eabad.png] 

Total triangles = 5 + 2 + 2 = 9

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
